name: Inspect immutable map fields
command: flock -s dumps/run-jfr-38/.matindex.lock java -Xmx3g -jar experiments/shapes/build/libs/shapes-experiment-all.jar mat-fields --hprof dumps/run-jfr-38/daemon.hprof --class com.google.common.collect.RegularImmutableMap --limit 5 --all > /tmp/fields-regular-map.txt && flock -s dumps/run-jfr-38/.matindex.lock java -Xmx3g -jar experiments/shapes/build/libs/shapes-experiment-all.jar mat-fields --hprof dumps/run-jfr-38/daemon.hprof --class com.google.common.collect.ImmutableMapEntry --limit 5 --all > /tmp/fields-immutable-entry.txt && flock -s dumps/run-jfr-38/.matindex.lock java -Xmx3g -jar experiments/shapes/build/libs/shapes-experiment-all.jar mat-fields --hprof dumps/run-jfr-38/daemon.hprof --class com.google.common.collect.ImmutableMapEntry$NonTerminalImmutableMapEntry --limit 5 --all > /tmp/fields-nonterminal-entry.txt
